Netanyahu Criticized by Mamdani, Responds with Accusations

Mahmood Mamdani, described in one report as a "Genocide Architect" and in another as a "Hamas Supporter," has drawn criticism from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Netanyahu stated, "Shame on you," in response to Mamdani ahead of a trip to New York City. This is not the first time Netanyahu has targeted Mamdani.
